title: This change will introduce build and autopkgtests to rust-sequoia-sq. It will not impact the binary package in any way and is thus a non-functional change.
description:
This change will introduce build and autopkgtests to rust-sequoia-sq. It will not impact the binary package in any way and is thus a non-functional change.

PPA: https://launchpad.net/~bamf0/+archive/ubuntu/stonking-rust-sequoia-sq-tests-lp21673063
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 8a68bf9..feb39a0 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+rust-sequoia-sq (1.4.0-0ubuntu2) stonking; urgency=medium
+
+  * debian/rules: Run cargo test during build (LP: #2167303)
+  * debian/tests: Add autopkgtest mirroring the cargo test to catch
+    regressions based on updates to rust-sequoia-sq's dependencies
+
+ -- Simon Johnsson <simon.johnsson@canonical.com>  Tue, 15 Sep 2026 15:54:07 +0200
+
 rust-sequoia-sq (1.4.0-0ubuntu1) stonking; urgency=medium
 
   * Package new upstream version (LP: #2161399):
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index 4e2e0c8..ab7a122 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -54,6 +54,11 @@ vendor:
 	git add debian/control
 	git commit debian/control -m "Update XS-Vendored-Sources-Rust field" || true
 
+override_dh_auto_test:
+	cargo test \
+	    --all-targets \
+            --offline
+
 override_dh_auto_configure:
 	DEB_CARGO_CRATE=sequoia-sq_$(shell dpkg-parsechangelog --show-field Version) \
 					$(CARGO) prepare-debian $(CARGO_VENDOR_DIR)
diff --git a/debian/tests/cargo-test b/debian/tests/cargo-test
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..a7ff188
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/tests/cargo-test
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+#!/bin/sh
+set -xeu
+
+# Create cargo config directory
+CARGO_TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'rm -rf "$CARGO_TMP_DIR"' EXIT
+
+# Create config.toml
+cat > $CARGO_TMP_DIR/config.toml << EOL
+[source.crates-io]
+replace-with = "vendored-sources"
+
+[source.vendored-sources]
+directory = "$(pwd)/debian/rust-vendor"
+EOL
+
+# Run the actual test
+export CARGO_HOME="$CARGO_TMP_DIR"
+# We explicitly test the installed rather than building a new package,
+# as this is the test other packages trigger
+export SEQUOIA_TEST_BIN=/usr/bin/sq
+
+debian/tests/run-cargo-tests
diff --git a/debian/tests/control b/debian/tests/control
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3aa6b0c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/tests/control
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+Tests: cargo-test
+Depends: @, @builddeps@
+Restrictions: allow-stderr
diff --git a/debian/tests/run-cargo-tests b/debian/tests/run-cargo-tests
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..416a46e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/tests/run-cargo-tests
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+#!/bin/sh
+# Shared helper script for centralizing arguments and features.
+# Callers can optionally pass test harness arguments to cargo like:
+# run-cargo-tests --skip test_1
+
+set -eu
+
+cargo test \
+    --all-targets \
+    --offline \
+    -- \
+    "$@"
